description:
Rate my Reel or Short: read one public short the way Hook Detector reads a clip (its
    first frames, its words heard by ElevenLabs Scribe v2) and rate it against the real
    finds on its subject (the Short form search over the last 30 days, ranked by their
    multiple over the creator's usual). Returns review_id, url, platform, video_id, subject,
    subject_from, clip (first_line, first_word_s, words_per_minute, longest_pause_s, words,
    heard_by, not_heard_why, onscreen_text, plays, multiple), reads (five, in order: stop,
    gap, momentum, feeling, reach; each with verdict strong, moderate or weak, says,
    computed_from counted against the finds, and finds: 1 to 3 ids from `finds`), finds
    (each a real video with its url, plays, multiple, first_line and pace), finds_from,
    label, credits_charged and credits. Never a guessed number. Costs 3 credits, taken
    first and given back on any failure: 422 invalid_link (before any charge), 404
    video_not_found (private or removed), 422 not_a_short, 422 review_not_possible (too few
    finds on the subject), 503 model_unavailable. 402 insufficient_credits under 3; limited
    per account per hour (429). Takes up to about 90 seconds. Needs research. Same as POST
    /v1/review/short.
